sn36.31:1.1: Atthi bhikkhave sāmisā pīti atthi nirāmisā pīti || atthi nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti || ||
sn36.31:1.2: Atthi sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ atthi nirāmisam sukhaṃ atthi nirāmisā nirāmisataraṃ sukhaṃ || ||
sn36.31:1.3: Atthi sāmisā upekhā atthi nirāmisā upekhā atthi nirāmisā niramisatarā upekhā || ||
sn36.31:1.4: Atthi sāmiso vimokkho atthi nirāmiso vimokkho atthi niramisā nirāmisataro vimokkho || || 4
sn36.31:1.8: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā || pe ||
sn36.31:1.9: kāyaviññeyyā poṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn36.31:1.11: Yā kho bhikkhave ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati pīti || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmisā pīti || || 5
sn36.31:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajam pītisukham pathamaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.31:2.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattam sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodhibhāvam avitakkam avicaraṃ samādhijam pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.31:3.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti || ||
sn36.31:3.2: Yā kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato uppajjati pīti || ayam vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā pīti || || 7
sn36.31:4.4: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā || pe ||
sn36.31:4.5: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn36.31:4.7: yaṃ kho bhikkhave ime pañcakāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ || idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmisaṃ sukhaṃ || || 8
sn36.31:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāram vivekajam pītisukham pathamaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.31:5.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvam avitakkam avicāraṃ samādhijam pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.31:5.4: pitiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti || yantam ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati || ||
sn36.31:6.1: Katamāñ ca bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisataraṃ sukhaṃ || ||
sn36.31:6.2: Yaṃ kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ || || Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisataraṃ sukhaṃ || || 10
sn36.31:7.4: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā || pi ||
sn36.31:7.5: kāyaviññeyyā poṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajaniyā ||
sn36.31:7.7: Yā kho bhikkhave ime pañcakāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati upekkhā || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sāmisā upekkhā || || 11
sn36.31:8.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānam atthagamā adukkhamasukham upekkhā satiparisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.31:9.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekkhā || ||
sn36.31:9.2: Yā kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato dosā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato mohā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato uppajjati upekkhā || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisatarā upekkhā || || 13-14
sn36.31:12.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkho || ||
sn36.31:12.2: Yo kho bhikkhave khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato || pe || mohā cittaṃ vimuttam paccavekkhato uppajjati vimokkho || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave nirāmisā nirāmisataro vimokkho ti || ||
